Package index

Package overview

RdistNN-package RdistNN
RdistNN: DNN Estimation for Conditional Effects and Regression

CATE and regression — estimators and weights

The main estimation workflows: conditional average treatment effects, nonparametric regression, and their DNN weight builders.

cate_dnn()
CATE via DNN rank-weighted pseudo-outcome averaging
np_dnn()
Nonparametric regression via DNN rank weights
np_tdnn()
Nonparametric regression via TDNN rank weights
weights_matrix()
Compute weight matrix W via an arbitrary ranking + weight mapping
weights_dnn()
DNN weights (choose method), distance-based ranking
weights_dnn_exact()
DNN weights (exact full-U), distance-based ranking
weights_dnn_asymp()
DNN weights (asymptotic full-U), distance-based ranking

Plotting

ggplot2-based panels for fitted objects (ggplot2 is a suggested dependency), and the tidy data extractors underneath them; see the visualization and diagnostics articles.

plot_estimates() autoplot.rdistnn_np_result() autoplot.rdistnn_cate_result() autoplot.rdistnn_affine_ratio_result() autoplot.rdistnn_plqr_result() autoplot.rdistnn_gmm_result() plot(<rdistnn_np_result>) plot(<rdistnn_cate_result>) plot(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) plot(<rdistnn_plqr_result>) plot(<rdistnn_gmm_result>)
Plot estimates with confidence bounds across target points
plot_weights()
Plot DNN weight profiles, concentration, and effective kernels
plot_overlap()
Plot local overlap for CATE and CLATE fits
plot_dashboard()
Compose a diagnostics dashboard for a fitted object
plot_influence()
Plot per-observation contributions to a CATE or CLATE estimating equation
plot_tuning()
Plot estimate sensitivity to the kernel order
autoplot.rdistnn_diagnostics() plot(<rdistnn_diagnostics>)
Plot per-target weight diagnostics
plot_data_estimates()
Extract a tidy estimates frame from a fitted RdistNN object
plot_data_weights()
Extract a tidy weight-profile frame from a fitted RdistNN object
plot_data_diagnostics()
Extract the per-target diagnostics frame from a fitted RdistNN object

General CATE simulation tools

Synthetic benchmarks and Monte Carlo summaries. The conditional Z-estimation paper uses the separate study-specific replication bundle.

sim_cate_data()
Draw one sample from a named CATE simulation DGP
sim_cate_one_rep()
Run one replicate of CATE estimators
sim_cate_run()
Run the CATE simulation grid
sim_cate_methods()
List available CATE simulation methods
summarise_sim_results()
Summarise raw per-replicate CATE simulation results

Conditional LATE and paired ratios

Supported supplied-prediction binary-IV signals and paired ratios with exact or asymptotic DNN weights. Shared reporting, candidate views and plots, with frozen-score covariance, diagnostics and the documented pointwise inference conditions.

clate_dnn()
Conditional LATE from externally supplied nuisance predictions
iv_augmented_signals()
Construct augmented reduced-form and first-stage signals
affine_ratio_dnn()
DNN inference for a ratio of two supplied signal averages
coef(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) vcov(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) confint(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) summary(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) print(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) print(<rdistnn_summary_affine_ratio_result>) predict(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>)
Reporting and prediction for paired affine-ratio results
diagnostics(<rdistnn_affine_ratio_result>) diagnostics(<rdistnn_clate_result>)
Paired component and first-stage diagnostics
clate_demo_data()
Bounded endogenous-treatment data for conditional LATE examples

Experimental — ratio confidence sets

Optional pointwise normal-reference inversion of paired moment inequalities. This helper does not establish weak-instrument-uniform coverage.

ratio_confidence_set() print(<rdistnn_ratio_confidence_sets>)
Confidence sets for a ratio of paired component estimates

Experimental — PLQR

Experimental moments and density-backed uncertainty at supplied coefficients. The wrapper does not solve for local coefficients; APIs and inference interfaces may change.

plqr_dnn()
PLQR local moment evaluation and direct coefficient inference via DNN rank weights (experimental)
plqr_score_matrix()
Observation-level orthogonal PLQR scores at a supplied coefficient (experimental)
score_plqr_component()
PLQR diagnostic score (component \(j\)); pure score (no weights, no fitting) (experimental)
plqr_demo_data()
Minimal PLQR demo data (oracle nuisances; no internal fitting) (experimental)
plqr_demo_subsets()
Quick helper: sample a batch of subsets (for U-stat / localization experiments) (experimental)
print(<rdistnn_plqr_result>)
Print a rdistnn_plqr_result object (experimental)
print(<rdistnn_summary_plqr_result>)
Print a rdistnn_summary_plqr_result (experimental)
summary(<rdistnn_plqr_result>)
Summarize a rdistnn_plqr_result (experimental)
confint(<rdistnn_plqr_result>)
Confidence intervals for rdistnn_plqr_result (experimental)
coef(<rdistnn_plqr_result>)
Extract coefficients from a rdistnn_plqr_result (experimental)
vcov(<rdistnn_plqr_result>)
Variance-covariance matrices for rdistnn_plqr_result (experimental)
predict(<rdistnn_plqr_result>)
Predict from a rdistnn_plqr_result object at new targets (experimental)
plot_conditioning()
Plot local design conditioning for PLQR fits (experimental)
plot_calibration()
Plot local quantile calibration for PLQR fits (experimental)

Advanced — TDNN and jackknife-paper infrastructure

Two-scale DNN estimation and the leave-one-out jackknife primitives supporting the generalized U-statistics companion paper.

weights_tdnn()
TDNN weights (choose method, k = 1), distance-based ranking
weights_tdnn_exact()
TDNN weights (exact, k = 1), distance-based ranking
weights_tdnn_asymp()
TDNN weights (asymptotic, k = 1), distance-based ranking
rank_weight_tdnn_exact()
Rank-weight spec: TDNN exact (Demirkaya two-scale DNN, k = 1)
rank_weight_tdnn_asymp()
Rank-weight spec: TDNN asymptotic (Demirkaya two-scale DNN, k = 1)
plot_tdnn_scales()
Plot the TDNN two-scale decomposition
jackknife_fast_rank()
Fast delete-one jackknife for rank-weighted functionals (auto C++ when available, R fallback otherwise)
jackknife_rank_full()
Generic rank-order delete-one jackknife (prefix/suffix engine)
jackknife_slow_rank()
Slow delete-one jackknife for rank-weighted L-stat rules (fixed ranks)
